adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the prior incremental PATCH update tests, including the case “succeeds silently when adding non-existent users”, and replaces membership changes with `add_members` (Admin::GroupsController#add_members). In `add_members`, usernames are split and each is guarded by `if user = User.find_by_username(username)` before `group.add(user)`, meaning invalid usernames are still silently skipped. The new spec `context ".add_members"` only asserts adding two valid users (`user1`, `user2`) and does not cover mixed valid/invalid input or verify the silent-skip behavior remains. This is a concrete missing-test gap for retained logic, not a runtime defect shown by the diff.
